notes.title: Sunrise GP Races Onto Steam: Mark Your Calendar for August 27th, 2024!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/1eeda774a29d6e4e8b39fcf0a0df828bbda40d2f.jpg[/img]
[h2]We’re thrilled to share the official release date of [b]Sunrise GP[/b] on Steam. [/h2]

[i]Get ready for an exhilarating racing adventure with a road trip twist! But that’s not all—here’s what you can expect from this game:
[/i]

🏆 [b]Arcade[/b] Gameplay: Perfect blend of high-speed racing and the relaxed vibes of a road trip.
🎵 [b]Synthwave[/b] Music: Each race is accompanied by unforgettable music that sets the mood.
🚗 [b]European Classic[/b]-Inspired Cars: Take the wheel of classic cars and explore vibrant locations.
🎨 [b]Customization[/b]: Personalize your car with decals, spoilers, exhausts, and more.
🎮 [b]Multiplayer[/b]: Gather your friends for split-screen multiplayer action (up to four players).
🏁 [b]Challenge[/b] Mode: Conquer single-player races in the core Grand Prix experience.
📸[b] Photomode[/b]: Capture stunning moments with your favorite cars against breathtaking backdrops.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/


Mark your calendar for August 27th, and stay with us as we count down the weeks to an epic gaming experience! 🎉🕶️🏁

notes.title: ⛺️ We travel looking for the most beautiful place to race 🎽
notes.notes:
[h3]Get ready for another adventure as we explore the awesome spots in Sunrise GP![/h3]

🎽 When we’re looking for the perfect place for racing, it turns out that the coolest places aren't far away—they're right under our noses. That's why we decided to mix things up with a comic book vibe, to highlight just how many cool spots are around us. Adding laid-back music and lots of digital sunshine, we get the title we wanted: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/][b]Sunrise GP[/b][/url].

That's why we invite you for a little sneak peek of what new locations await you in the game:

[h3][b]Feel the Mountain Breeze:
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/88bb9fa9b43dd546516bf2d2c4c4e59ea103be51.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/838a2ff908c0de115a7280163b9200d3ee02ccde.jpg[/img]

🎽 The fiery aurora borealis in the sky creates the perfect atmosphere while driving through intricate mountain roads. The air is crisp, and the surrounding greenery is clear and vibrant.

[h3][b]Postcard from the sea: Port Seaside:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/274f77ebad5a57788d0bf9fd65533873a68b6322.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/c05ac2db70b7845dcdb095c9201325810bd6bf5a.jpg[/img]

🎽 Here, we are separated from the beautiful, carefree sea by a port where large ships arrive. However, the sight of containers and windmills creates a pleasant atmosphere, reminiscent of traveling through another noteworthy location.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/

Soon we will show you even more - stay with us and follow Sunrise GP! This is an arcade racer that is suitable for both cozy gameplay alone and for four-player races on a split screen.

[i]~Garage 5 & Gamedust Team

[/i]

notes.title: 🌄The journey persists as we explore new roads! 🤘
notes.notes:
[h3]We drive at full speed and with full courage to subsequent locations that offer beautiful, memorable views. Start your engines and come with us![/h3]

🌄Here is the fourth installment (you've seen [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2670800/view/4174344193749284503?l=polish]1[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2670800/view/4159708130877540977?l=polish]2[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2670800/view/4133813065582576097?l=polish]3[/url]) where we unveil glimpses of levels from [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/]Sunrise GP[/url][/b]. One of the most important elements of this game from the beginning has been to capture its atmosphere accurately. In addition to the thrill of racing, we aim to provide moments of relaxation.

[i]So let's check out the next two routes:[/i]

[h3]Driving through roads of Dry Lake - County:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/f2e25d9d0e7c6350e11a8db6568121d42f9a90a1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/4dc6d126d42f4b6abb0fb6f2ab10e98726764080.jpg[/img]
🌄Imagine a post-apocalyptic environment reminiscent of scenes from Mad Max, with a cheerful race of colorful cars at its very center. We've played with the contrast between the hostile desert environment and the joy of racing, and we're sure you'll like it!

[h3]Experience the Marshland - Blooming greeny level:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/67f444886a39cd3b0f73ae35e685e6613ce73089.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/b53c86b1cf27bd2da80dd23531b6a2a3a816800a.jpg[/img]
🌄Driving through the Marshland on a beautiful spring day, with plants blooming all around, it's hard to imagine a better way to spend a day. The sunlight filtering through the trees and mountains adds an extra touch of brilliance, leaving nothing left to do but finish this race on the podium!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/

Stay with us and wait for further posts about Sunrise GP and the release date announcement! We're making an arcade racer for everyone - remember that on each presented track, you'll also be able to race with four people on a split screen!

[i]~Garage 5 & Gamedust Team
[/i]

notes.title: 🐯Sun, desert and caves - a great journey around the world in Sunrise GP
notes.notes:
[h3]We continue to present the wonderful places where you will race in Sunrise GP, soaking up the atmosphere of a great road adventure.[/h3]

🐯 Similar to our previous entries ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2670800/view/4174344193749284503?l=english]1[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2670800/view/4159708130877540977?l=english]2[/url]), we invite you to examine the diverse routes available in our game. [b]All images are captured through Photo Mode[/b], offering a glimpse into the unique road trip atmosphere. While working on Sunrise GP, we believe that driving a car is an immersive and enriching experience, and we are dedicated to conveying that sentiment.

Let's take a look at the next two routes:

[h3]Check how sunlight bathes the road in the Underground - Miracle level
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/05580224c5bf1ac972677890e0b9473aabac630d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/2a7cbe949a0ea518e971b406d064b7c59151e3b2.jpg[/img]
🐯 Riding through a broad roadway within an expansive cave, with beams of light streaming in through the cracks – it's an experience worth remembering. Additionally, massive machines loom nearby, and within the tunnels, fierce competition for the top spot in the race intensifies. Sunrise GP will offer captivating views and evoke powerful emotions!

[h3]Locate the race in the expansive desert, situated adjacent to the space rocket launch site on the Kosmodrom - Desert level[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/3bd2829ec3d431363fde7c0d33364d108c4708da.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/60e630fccf25a5c8575d454da54ca3a039a72fe7.jpg[/img]
🐯 Experience the feeling of driving with your favorite song playing on the radio, pressing down on the gas pedal, all while giant rockets stand ready to launch into space beside you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/

This is just some of what you will see in the full game. If you resonate with the direction of our arcade racer, [b]be sure to add our game to your wishlist and share the excitement with your friends![/b] Stay tuned for more details coming your way soon.

[i]Garage 5 & Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: 🏔️Come on a trip to Frozen Fiords and Green Valley with Sunrise GP
notes.notes:
[h3]Discover the enchanting beauty of a pink sky concealed behind the majestic peaks of snow-capped mountains. Immerse yourself in the picturesque settings at Sunrise GP![/h3]

As mentioned in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2670800/view/4174344193749284503?l=english]last entry[/url], [b]we aim to take you to Sunrise GP not only for a race but also for a memorable trip[/b].

🚦While we may not boast a game with a photorealistic backdrop, our dedicated team has put effort into ensuring that each route delivers a positive and engaging experience. As [b]fans of old-school arcade racers[/b], we aim to refresh the genre in a new form, hoping you will appreciate it!

Now, let's take a sneak peek at the next two exhilarating levels:

[h3]First, gaze upon the clear snow and rosy skies of the Frozen Fiords - Sunrise level:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/8572e4e66806cd17fd9f8aef90b8defb9696fba0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/05cd814dc90d566d77f28c5bfe28b84c682774a1.jpg[/img]
🚦Picture yourself navigating through tunnels and cruising across a frozen lake amidst the breathtaking expanse of nature. If you seek such exhilarating experiences, rest assured, we've got you covered.

[h3]Next, immerse yourself in the morning fog of Green Valley - Vista level:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/4ddefd9cc37b0fa28633a207709eefaf2722ab47.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/c6901821fe162c6fc2777653046dc513d4a25229.jpg[/img]
🚦As you exit the tunnel, witness the beauty of a morning in the mountains with a passing train overhead: the weather is beautiful, and you are driving your favorite car to the tunes of your favorite music. Can life get any better?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/

[b]This is just a glimpse[/b] of what awaits you in the full game! Don't forget to add it to your wishlist and stay tuned for upcoming announcements. With your support, we can reach more fans of classic racing.

[i]Garage 5 & Gamedust Team
[/i]

notes.title: ☀️Welcome to the road to the sun! 💌
notes.notes:
[h3]It's time to peek under the hood of European automotive classics; or rather, under the hood of our emotion-filled arcade racer.[/h3]

🚦Starting the development of [b]Sunrise GP[/b], we aimed to create a racing game in the style we yearn for - an easygoing, laid-back race where the joy of driving blends with bright colors, pleasant music, and a relaxing atmosphere (however, we didn't abandon the idea of competition, so for those seeking to compete for the top spot, there will also be fitting challenges available).

That's why we invite everyone to take a look at the tracks where you'll be racing in [b]Sunrise GP[/b]!

[h3]The first thing you'll see in the game is Sunny Beach - Paradiso:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/79027c5819aeb4dce4ce01a2fd2f34d444e4893e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/0e34b8210d3b70f681a04746dc22d319a6abc4a3.jpg[/img]
🚦This place is bathed in sunlight, surrounded by palm trees and beach vibes.

[h3]The second location you'll come across is Marshland - Mellow:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/735454a12b3b693d6ea6f931b5b2d823dcefbfd2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790732/ee73590fc84ffaba007487027bdf3215ab636bed.jpg[/img]
🚦Imagine driving at dawn amidst green mountains, through an industrial area integrated into the forest and nature. It's summer, it's warm; in the air, you can feel that it recently rained, and the radio plays the perfect music...

[b]It's precisely for these experiences that we made Sunrise GP![/b]

🚦These are just selected scenes, and there are many more surprises and beautiful views waiting for you on the track! So, if you like what you've seen, add the game to your wishlist, tell your friends about it, and stay tuned for the announcement of the exact release date!


[i]~Garage 5 & Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: Sunrise GP will land in 2024 on Steam!
notes.notes:
Introducing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/?beta=0][b]Sunrise GP[/b][/url] - Your Ultimate Roadtrip Adventure on Steam! 

[previewyoutube=XQp6bjcA7lw;full][/previewyoutube]

Are you ready for an [b]exhilarating racing action [/b]combined with a [b]road trip vibe[/b]? We've got just the title for you – Sunrise GP set to make its debut on Steam in 2024!

Following the successful launch on Nintendo Switch in April 2023, where it garnered rave reviews, we've been hard at work to bring excitement to the PC gaming community. Now, you can explore the sunny Grand Prix landscapes right from the comfort of your computer.

[h3]What to expect from Sunrise GP:[/h3]

🏆 Immerse yourself in [b]arcade gameplay [/b]that seamlessly blends [b]high-speed racing with the laid-back vibes [/b]of a road trip.
🏆 Soak in [b]synth-wave music [/b]that enhances the atmosphere of each race, creating a memorable experience.
🏆 Drive [b]cars inspired by European classics [/b]through [b]retro-inspired locations [/b]vibrant in colors.
🏆 [b]Customize your car's appearance [/b]with a plethora of options, including decals, spoilers, exhausts, and more!
🏆 Enjoy [b]multiplayer [/b]fun with split-screen capability, accommodating up to four players for a thrilling gaming session.
🏆 Take on the [b]Challenge Mode[/b], a series of single-player races that make up the titular Grand Prix.
🏆 Capture stunning moments with the [b]in-game Photomode[/b], showcasing your favorite cars in breathtaking localisations.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670800/Sunrise_GP/?beta=0

And this is just a sneak peek! Stay tuned as we unveil more details about Sunrise GP in upcoming posts.

If you're a fan of arcade racing, a lively atmosphere, and the joy of multiplayer gaming on a split screen, buckle up and join us for the ride!
